from: July book, night 14 (More Are with Us)
p1: One night, the king of Syria sent soldiers all around Elisha’s city. They had horses and chariots, carts pulled by horses.
In the morning, Elisha’s helper saw them. He was afraid. He said, “Oh no, master! What shall we do?”
Elisha said, “Do not be afraid. There are more with us than with them.”
p2: Elisha prayed, “Lord, please open his eyes, so he can see.” Then the helper saw it! The mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha! Heavenly Father was keeping them safe. Later, Elisha had the soldiers fed and sent home.
Heavenly Father is with you too. Even in the dark, you are never alone. Tonight, say a little prayer and feel Him near.
old: An enemy army wanted to catch Elisha. One morning, Elisha’s young helper woke up and saw soldiers all around the city! “Oh no!” he cried. “What are we going to do?”
But Elisha was calm. “Don’t be afraid,” he said. “There are more helpers with us than there are enemies.” The young man looked around and felt scared and confused. He couldn’t see any helpers.
So Elisha prayed, “Lord, open his eyes so he can see.” Suddenly the young man saw the hills full of horses and chariots of FIRE! God’s mighty helpers were everywhere, protecting them.
Heavenly Father sends help we cannot always see. Angels and His power are all around us. When we feel scared, we don’t have to be — God is bigger than anything. We are never really alone.
